answer: The nebula index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1535 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the jade. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the pearl queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. The deposit is 32 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
